whatIsIt.eli5: Throws away guesses the model is not sure about.
whatIsIt.simple: Keeps only predictions whose class score is above a threshold (0.25 by default for prediction).
whatIsIt.engineer: Score threshold on max class probability (default conf = 0.25 for predict, 0.001 for validation).

whyExists.eli5: Most of the 8,400 guesses are about empty ground.
whyExists.simple: Nearly all cells contain background; filtering them early makes the next steps fast.
whyExists.engineer: Removes low-score anchors before NMS/top-k to bound post-processing cost.

eli5: Keep it only if the score is high enough.
simple: Take the highest class score per prediction.
Drop it if below the threshold.
engineer: Lower conf raises recall and false positives; mAP is computed with conf = 0.001.
